items.body:
<details open>

vulkan: fix out-of-bounds NVFP4 UE4M3 scale lookup (#31079)

* vulkan : fix out-of-bounds NVFP4 UE4M3 scale lookup

On the non-OCP path, ue4m3_fp32_lut has 128 entries and is indexed with the raw scale byte. ggml_validate_row_data accepts every byte and ggml_ue4m3_to_fp32 ignores bit 7, so a byte >= 0x80 reads past the shared array. Vulkan robustness does not cover shared memory.

Size the table, both init loops, and the two host shared-memory budgets to 256 entries. ue4m3_to_fp32_build() already masks the exponent and treats only 0 and 0x7F as special, so entries 128-255 match the CPU. A 256-entry table keeps 0xFF distinct from 0x7F: the CPU decodes 0xFF as a non-zero value and 0x7F as zero.

Each NVFP4 pipeline uses 512 more bytes of shared memory. ggml_fp32_to_ue4m3 never sets bit 7, so models quantized by llama.cpp are unaffected.

Assisted-by: Claude
Assisted-by: Codex

items.body:
<details open>

llama : drop the redundant cnv from llm_attn_mask (#31558)

The dspark block mask is now derived at input-fill time: llm_attn_mask::block_uniform
fills every token of a sequence with the mask row of its first token, so the
graph-level reshape/repeat in dflash is gone and cnv always aliases raw.
